title: Vertex-minor Ramsey numbers: exact values and extremal structure
summary: We determine the vertex-minor Ramsey number $\Rvm(4)=11$, where $\Rvm(k)$ is the smallest~$n$ such that every $n$-vertex graph contains the edgeless graph~$E_k$ as a vertex-minor. We prove this by an exhaustive classification of the graphs on~$10$ and~$11$ vertices under local complementation. At the extremal order $n=10$, exactly six non-isomorphic graphs avoid~$E_4$ as a vertex-minor; up to isomorphism, they represent five LC-equivalence classes, and each labeled LC orbit has cardinality~$8{,}712$.
